description: Generate an observer class and its events.xml subscription (global or per area), adapted from the official events and observers docs. Returns the files for the caller to write. Use it to react to a dispatched event.

area.description: global (etc/events.xml, all areas) or one area folder (default global)

basePath.description: Module directory relative to the Commerce root (default "app/code/<Vendor>/<Module>")

module.description: Module name as Vendor_Module (e.g. "Acme_Reviews"), as registered in registration.php

observerClass.description: Observer class name inside <Module>\Observer (default derived from the event name)

observerName.description: Observer name in events.xml (unique per event)

name: add-observer

files.description: Files to write. The server never writes to disk.

path.description: Path relative to the Commerce root

source.description: Documentation page the template was adapted from

title: Add an event observer
